content.title: Everything We Know About Taylor Sheridan’s ‘The Madison’ So Far
content.text: Taylor Sheridan’s Yellowstone universe has lassoed another offshoot — The Madison — which arrives in March. Deadline exclusively confirmed an offshoot of Yellowstone with Kelly Reilly and Cole Hauser in the works, and the Luke Grimes centered spinoff will arrive the same month as The Madison. For everything we know about The Madison, read on. When does The Madison come out? Watch on Deadline Visit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGE The series will premiere March 14 on Paramount+. The first three episodes debut that day, and the next three arrive the following week on March 21. Is there a trailer for The Madison? Yes, a trailer was released Feb. 24. What is The Madison about? The Madison will follow the McIntosh family, a New York City family living in the Madison River valley of central Montana. RELATED: ‘Yellowstone’ Finale: How Taylor Sheridan Wrapped Up (For Now) His Hit Drama On Paramount Who will be in The Madison? Kevin Zegers is the latest addition to the next installment in the Yellowstone universe. He will play Cade, new neighbor of Michelle Pfeiffer‘s Stacy Clyburn. Cade is responsible for looking after their property until they arrive. Danielle Vasinova’s role was also recently revealed. She will be portraying Kestrel, an indigenous woman married to a Montana rancher as a supporting role in the series. THE MADISON: (L-R): Beau Garett as Abigail Reese, Alaina Pollack as Macy Reese, Amiah Miller as Bridgett Reese Emerson Miller/Paramount+ Michelle Pfeiffer was first confirmed to headline the spinoff. She will play the mother of two daughters — Beau Garrett and Elle Chapman. Chapman’s character is Paige McIntosh, who luxuriates in the New York lifestyle perpetuated by her parents and husband. Patrick J. Adams will play Russell McIntosh, Paige’s investment banker husband. Garett will play Abigail Reese, a New York mother of two who is recently divorced. Amiah Miller will play Abigail’s oldest daughter Brigitte. Deadline exclusively reported Matthew Fox’s boarding of the project in the role of bachelor Paul, who loves the outdoors. RELATED: ‘Yellowstone’ Creator Taylor Sheridan Hired A Supermodel To Play His Galpal On Drama, Naturally Kurt Russell’s joining the project was finally confirmed in early September 2025. Who else is behind The Madison? The show is produced by MTV Entertainment Studios, 101 Studios and Bosque Ranch Productions. Creator Sheridan will executive produce alongside Pfeiffer, David C. Glasser, John Linson, Art Linson, Bob Yari, David Hutkin, Christina Voros, Michael Friedman and Keith Cox. RELATED: ‘Lioness’ & ‘The Madison’ Poised For Renewals As New Paramount Brass Praise Taylor Sheridan & He Opens New Texas Campus With 101 Studios Will there be multiple seasons of The Madison? Deadline heard that the show will receive an early renewal. Are there other Yellowstone spinoffs? Yes, 1923 starring Harrison Ford and Helen Mirren came back for a second season in February 2025. 1883, another prequel show starring Tim McGraw and Faith Hill, has one season available to stream. An offshoot of Yellowstone led by Kelly Reilly and Cole Hauser is also in the works, as Deadline exclusively reported. RELATED: ‘Yellowstone’s Cole Hauser Teases Spinoff Ahead Of Series Finale: “We’ll See What’s Next” Y: Marshals, starring Luke Grimes Kayce Dutton, will premiere March 1 on Paramount+.
